Limits of this check

This is a research estimate from five public profile details. It was tested on one platform and is much less reliable on others. It can be wrong even when it sounds confident. It does not show who runs an account or what they have done, and it is not proof of anything.
How well does this work?

On 118 Instagram accounts the model had not seen, it ranked accounts well (AUROC 0.97, where 1.0 is perfect and 0.5 is a coin toss). On a different platform it was much less reliable (AUROC 0.82), and it missed some account types completely, sometimes while sounding confident.
